title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
**Software Engineer**
**Overview**
We are seeking a skilled
**Software Engineer**
to join our Software Engineering team. This role sits between the Associate Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer levels, requiring a solid foundation in software engineering principles along with practical experience delivering production-ready applications.
  
  
The successful candidate will develop and maintain web applications using React for the front end, .NET C# Web API for the back end, and SQL for database management. They will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software solutions while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and technical best practices.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications using React, .NET C# Web API, and SQL.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following established coding standards and best practices.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Apply object-oriented programming principles, design patterns, and software engineering best practices.
* Develop and optimize database queries and contribute to database design and performance improvements.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and application issues.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation for applications, APIs, and development processes.
* Contribute to code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Develop reusable components and shared functionality to improve development efficiency.
* Support application performance, scalability, and security initiatives.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, development tools, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–5 years of professional software development experience in a commercial environment.
* Strong proficiency in .NET C#, ASP.NET Core/Web API, React, and SQL.
* Experience with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and modern web development concepts.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, source control (Git), the software development lifecycle (SDLC), data structures and algorithms, and relational database design and normalization.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging complex application issues.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Understanding of software security principles and secure coding practices.
* Ability to analyze requirements and develop scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Exposure to cloud-based environments and deployment practices.
* Experience with Python or other programming languages.
* Experience developing reusable component libraries or shared frameworks.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with Vite or similar front-end build tools.

title: Professional, AI Developer
description:

title: Manager Software Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**highly skilled and visionary Software Engineering Manager**
to lead a team of engineers in building Caterpillar’s next-generation
**Digital Manufacturing Data Platform**
. This platform is central to our Future of Manufacturing initiative—designed to unify and operationalize data across design, engineering, production, and supply chain operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in
**Big Data, Data Warehousing, real-time data movement**
, and
**Snowflake-based architectures**
. You will architect and deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent data platforms that enable advanced analytics, AI, and digital twin capabilities across global manufacturing ecosystems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of data engineers and platform developers.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Drive Agile practices and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Technical Strategy & Architecture**

* Architect and oversee the development of scalable, secure, and resilient data platforms.
* Design and implement near real-time data movement and streaming architectures using tools like Kafka, Spark, and cloud-native services.
* Establish best practices in data modelling, ETL/ELT, data governance, and metadata management.

**Data Engineering & Snowflake Expertise**

* Lead the development of robust data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and delivery using Snowflake, and cloud-native tools.
* Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing for performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
* Implement data quality frameworks, lineage tracking, and schema evolution strategies.

**Big Data & Data Warehousing**

* Build and maintain large-scale data lakes and data warehouses for structured and unstructured data.
* Design scalable data architectures to support manufacturing analytics, predictive maintenance, and supply chain optimization.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering**

* Leverage AWS and Azure services for data ingestion, transformation, and analytics.
* Deploy software using CI/CD tools (git, Jenkins, AWS CloudFormation).
* Ensure platform scalability, security, and operational readiness across global deployments.

**AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement**

* Collaborate with Data Science and AI teams to operationalize ML models and analytics workflows.
* Promote integration of AI capabilities into data engineering pipelines (e.g., GenAI, MCP, ATA).
* Support real-time analytics and edge AI use cases in manufacturing environments.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with product managers, manufacturing SMEs, and business leaders to understand requirements and deliver impactful data solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence strategic decisions.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven experience in Big Data processing and Data Warehousing.
* Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP.
* Strong architecture exposure for building robust, scalable Data Platforms.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake, SQL, NoSQL, and distributed data systems.
* Strong analytical skills and solid knowledge of computer science fundamentals.
* Deep exposure to AWS and Azure cloud platforms.
* Good understanding of AI concepts and latest developments (Gen AI, MCP, ATA, etc.).

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Knowledge of the NVIDIA ecosystem and its applications in data and AI.
* Experience building production-ready AI solutions and integrating with MLOps workflows.
* Familiarity with modern data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success in managing engineering teams and delivering complex data solutions.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 13, 2026 - October 22, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AIML
description:

Lead the architecture and delivery of scalable ML/RL systems at Kaleris. title: Associate Software Engineer Intern - YMS
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Kaleris builds Yard Management Systems (YMS) that control and optimize the movement of goods throughout the supply chain — across gates, yards, docks, and drivers. We are actively expanding our YMS platform with new automation capabilities including gate intelligence, real-time yard visibility, and driver self-service workflows.
  
  
As an intern on this team, you'll contribute to real engineering problems on a live product. You'll be assigned to one or more focus areas based on team needs and your own strengths — which may shift during the internship as priorities evolve. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed enough to ramp up on a new area with limited hand-holding.
  
  
**What You May Work On**
Your work will fall within either of the following areas, depending on where the team needs you most:
  
  

* Gate Automation & Computer Vision (Research & Prototype)
* Explore and prototype computer vision and OCR approaches for automated detection of truck and trailer data at yard gates — trailer numbers, license plates, cab numbers, USDOT numbers, and seal presence
* Build and evaluate training data pipelines using publicly available datasets and real-world gate imagery
* Benchmark detection accuracy and document what is achievable in-house vs. what would require significant investment
* Assess feasibility of running detection models on edge hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson or equivalent)
* YMS Platform Feature Development
* Work on backend features within the Kaleris YMS platform — contributing to gate workflow logic, shipment management, dock door assignments, or yard inventory tracking
* Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews
* Help reduce manual data entry pain points through automation and smarter integrations

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* Currently pursuing a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (final or pre-final year)
* Solid programming fundamentals in at least one language — Python, Java, or similar
* Any hands-on project or coursework involving computer vision, OCR, or machine learning (academic, personal, or Kaggle — show us the code)
* Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow, and Python data libraries (OpenCV, NumPy)
* Ability to pick up new technologies independently — you won't have a dedicated senior in every focus area
* Clear written communication — you'll need to document your work and surface blockers clearly
* Genuine curiosity about how software solves real operational problems

**Good To Have**

* Web development experience — frontend or backend
* Ruby on Rails familiarity — our YMS platform has Rails components; any Rails or web backend experience is a strong plus
* Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven systems, or database design
* Interest in logistics, yard/warehouse operations, or supply chain technology

**What You'll Get**

* Exposure to a real, production YMS platform used by major logistics operators
* Ownership of a meaningful deliverable — not a sandbox exercise
* Flexibility to contribute across different areas of the product based on where you add the most value

Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Sr. Software Engineer B3
description:
**Job Summary**
Sr Software Engineer B3 will design and deliver high quality enterprise applications using Angular C Sharp SQL Azure JavaScript and Net Framework within a hybrid work model. The role focuses on building secure scalable solutions for investment banking and brokerage operations ensuring resilient performance data integrity and seamless user experiences that support global financial services and societal trust in digital markets.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust front end features using Angular versions thirteen to sixteen to deliver intuitive responsive and accessible user interfaces for complex investment banking workflows and brokerage operations.
* Develop high quality server side components using C Sharp and Net Framework that provide secure performant and reusable services to support transaction processing and operational efficiency.
* Architect and optimize database schemas and queries in SQL to ensure high reliability data integrity and fast execution for large scale financial datasets and reporting needs.
* Integrate applications with Azure services including app hosting storage and monitoring to achieve scalable resilient and maintainable cloud solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
* Collaborate with product owners business analysts and operations stakeholders to translate investment banking and brokerage requirements into detailed technical designs and implementation plans.
* Implement clean modular JavaScript and TypeScript code for complex client side logic improving usability reducing defects and supporting long term maintainability of the front end.
* Apply secure coding practices and conduct rigorous code reviews to reduce vulnerabilities ensure regulatory compliance and safeguard sensitive financial and customer information.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production and nonproduction incidents by analyzing logs performance metrics and user feedback to restore stability and prevent recurrence.
* Create and maintain detailed technical documentation including design specifications configuration details and deployment steps to support knowledge sharing and operational continuity.
* Coordinate with quality engineering teams to define test strategies build automated test suites and validate functionality performance and security requirements before releases.
* Plan and execute application deployments and configuration changes in Azure and related environments ensuring minimal downtime and smooth transition through careful validation and rollback strategies.
* Mentor junior engineers through constructive feedback pairing and guidance on best practices in Angular C Sharp SQL and cloud technologies to elevate overall team capability.
* Engage in continuous improvement initiatives by proposing enhancements to architecture coding standards and tooling that improve development velocity and system reliability.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate eight to twelve years of experience in software engineering with a strong track record of delivering enterprise applications in hybrid work settings.
* Possess advanced hands on expertise in Angular versions thirteen to sixteen including component design state management and performance tuning for complex web applications.
* Show deep proficiency in C Sharp and Net Framework for building scalable secure and reusable backend services used in mission critical financial systems.
* Exhibit strong skills in SQL development including query optimization indexing and schema design to support high volume transactional and analytical workloads.
* Bring practical experience with Azure services such as web apps storage identity and monitoring to design and operate cloud based solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Apply solid knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript including modern patterns and frameworks to ensure maintainable and testable front end implementations.
* Preferably have domain exposure to investment banking operations and investment banking and brokerage to understand trade lifecycles regulatory constraints and operational processes.

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:

Build and delivery

Partner enablement and quality

* Data modelling. Strong data-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience enabling a partner or delivery ecosystem, or leading a small technical team.
* Familiarity with API design, scripting, or integration middleware.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:

**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

**Office of the CTO**

**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight

* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.

* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer(ServiceMax)
description:
**Position: Senior Salesforce Developer**
**Location: Chennai (Onsite)**
Shift: UK Shift ( 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM )
  
  
Experience : 7+ years overall
  
  
Interviews: Assessment || 2 Interview rounds.
  
  
***Notice Period: Immediate Joiners only***
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities:**
We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer with 5–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, Salesforce Admin experience and strong expertise in Salesforce.com, Lightning, Apex, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Agentforce. The ideal candidate will have experience delivering enterprise Salesforce implementations and developing scalable solutions using Salesforce best practices.
  
  
Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions on the Salesforce Platform.
  
  
Develop custom Salesforce functionality using Apex, Triggers, Trigger Frameworks, Queueable Apex, Batch Apex, SOQL, and Web Services.
  
  
Build modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura Components.
  
  
Configure and develop solutions across Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  
  
Develop and support Agentforce solutions and integrations based on business requirements.
  
  
Design and troubleshoot integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, Middleware, and ETL tools.
  
  
Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
  
  
Follow Salesforce best practices, governor limits, order of execution, coding standards, and Agile development methodologies.
  
  
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver enterprise Salesforce solutions.
  
  
**Required Skills And Experience**
5–7+ years of Salesforce development experience.
  
  
Experience delivering 3+ Salesforce project implementations.
  
  
Strong enterprise experience across Salesforce.com, Lightning, Apex, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Agentforce.
  
  
5–7+ years of Salesforce development experience with multiple Salesforce implementations.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce.com, Lightning, Apex, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud.
  
  
**Experience With Agentforce And Salesforce AI Capabilities.**
Strong back-end development skills including Apex, Triggers, Trigger Frameworks, Queueable Apex, Batch Apex, and SOQL.
  
  
Strong understanding of Salesforce Governor Limits and Order of Execution.
  
  
Experience developing Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura Components.
  
  
Experience with Salesforce integrations, including REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, Middleware, and ETL tools.
  
  
**Experience With MuleSoft And Debugging Integration Issues Is Preferred.**
Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or similar version-control platforms.
  
  
Experience with Salesforce deployment tools such as VS Code/SFDX, Copado, Gearset, or similar tools.
  
  
Experience working in large enterprise Salesforce environments.
  
  
Strong communication, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with peer code reviews and coding standards.
  
  
**Nice to Have**
Hands-on experience with ServiceMax implementations and configurations.
  
  
Experience with ServiceMax modules such as Work Orders, Installed Products, Contracts, Preventive Maintenance, and Service Agreements.
  
  
Experience with ProntoForms mobile forms integrated with Salesforce/ServiceMax.
  
  
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Agentforce-related certifications.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
KLA advanced computing Labs’ (ACL) mission in India is to deliver advanced parallel computing research and software architectures for AI + HPC + Cloud solutions to accelerate the performance of KLA's products. ACL explores high-risk approaches, pioneering technologies, and novel methods to accelerate KLA’s algorithms and contribute to KLA’s HPC technology roadmap. Located out of the IIT Madras Research Park in Chennai, India, we engage leading thinkers in academia, industry and KLA’s business units to create innovative parallel computing methods to enable KLA’s business growth.
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled
**Software Engineer**
to join our dynamic team focused on
**scientific computing and modelling solutions**
. This role is ideal for engineers with a strong background in
**C# or C++**
, and experience developing on the
**.NET/Windows platform**
.
  
  
You will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of software used for
**modelling and computational workflows**
that support CD and thin film measurement systems. You will work closely with scientists and engineers to translate complex computational requirements into
**robust, scalable, and high-performance software solutions**
.
  
  
**🔹**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain software applications using C# or C++ on the .NET/Windows platform.
* Collaborate with scientists and engineers to translate modelling and computational requirements into robust software solutions.
* Design and development of scalable, performant, and maintainable software solutions for computationally intensive applications.
* Optimize code for performance, scalability, and efficiency in scientific computing environments.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and validation to ensure high-quality deliverables.
* Contribute to UI/UX design and implementation where applicable.
* Document software designs, workflows, and usage for internal and external stakeholders.

**🔹 Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of professional experience in software development.
* Proficiency in C# or C++, with strong knowledge of the .NET framework and Windows development.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems.
* Experience in scientific computing, modelling, or computationally intensive applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Experience translating complex requirements into technical architecture and execution plans.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle complex technical challenges.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills in global team environments.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf).

**🔹 Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)**

* Experience in building complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design principles and tools.
* Exposure to semiconductor, metrology, or modelling domains is a plus.

**🔹**
**What We Offer**

* A collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Opportunities to work on cutting-edge scientific modelling and engineering challenges.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Career growth and development opportunities.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Senior Developer, Applications
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, Axiom, with the spin planned for Q1 2027. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support Axiom, a company focused on critical digital infrastructure and delivering end-to-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission-critical applications.
  
  
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a
**Senior Developer, Applications**
in
**Chennai, India.**
**What a typical day looks like:**

* Design, build new applications using .Net

title: Network Systems Developer
description:
As a Network Monitoring & Observability Engineer, you will be responsible for administering network monitoring platforms, defining monitoring standards, and automating observability solutions. You will support both current and future monitoring technologies while ensuring operational reliability and meaningful visibility into network performance, availability, and health.
  
  
This role requires a strong understanding of network monitoring principles, enterprise networking, Linux administration, and Python-based automation.
  
  
Network Management System Administration
  
  

* Administer enterprise monitoring platforms such as SevOne, Netcool, ThousandEyes, ScienceLogic, Selector.ai, LogicMonitor, and Prometheus.
* Manage platform installations, upgrades, patching, maintenance, and lifecycle activities.
* Monitor system health, capacity, and platform performance.

Monitoring Strategy & Standards
  
  

* Design and maintain monitoring standards and templates.
* Define key performance indicators and alerting thresholds for routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and other network infrastructure.
* Implement baselining and anomaly detection strategies.

Linux Platform Administration
  
  

* Manage Linux servers supporting monitoring platforms.
* Maintain operating systems, file systems, databases, security configurations, and scheduled jobs.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure issues impacting monitoring services.

Automation & Integration
  
  

* Develop Python scripts to automate device onboarding, reporting, and platform integrations.
* Integrate monitoring platforms using REST APIs and automation workflows.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation and self-service capabilities.

Configuration & Version Management
  
  

* Use Git for version control of scripts, configuration files, and automation artifacts.
* Maintain documentation and change history for production configurations.

Data Collection & Telemetry
  
  

* Configure and optimize Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP), Syslog, NetFlow, sFlow, IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX), and streaming telemetry.
* Ensure reliable collection, storage, and analysis of monitoring data.

**Required Qualifications**
Network Monitoring & Observability
  
  

* Strong understanding of network monitoring principles including polling intervals, retention policies, baselining, and anomaly detection.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Strong knowledge of SNMP, including MIBs, OIDs, notifications, and security models.
* Experience implementing traffic-flow monitoring using NetFlow, sFlow, or IPFIX.

Networking Fundamentals
  
  

* CCNA-level understanding of TCP/IP networking concepts.
* Knowledge of latency, packet loss, jitter, routing, and subnetting.
* Understanding of routing protocols and network health indicators, including BGP and OSPF.
* Ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues involving firewalls, ACLs, and routing.

Linux Administration
  
  

* Experience administering Linux systems such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, or Ubuntu.
* Familiarity with log analysis, system performance troubleshooting, and database fundamentals.

Automation & Development
  
  

* Proficiency in Python scripting.
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs.
* Experience using Git and modern version-control workflows.
* Preferred Qualifications

+ Experience migrating between network monitoring or observability platforms.
+ Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or similar observability solutions.
+ Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
+ Experience with time-series databases and telemetry architectures.
+ Exposure to cloud-based network monitoring solutions.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. ****Job Description****
**Do you want to develop enterprise applications that support critical business operations for a global manufacturing organization?**

You'll be responsible for delivering high-quality software solutions using Microsoft Dynamics AX, X++, SQL Server, .NET, and related technologies, while supporting the ongoing evolution, stability, and maintainability of our business-critical systems.
  
  
This role is ideal for an experienced developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working with enterprise systems, and delivering reliable software solutions, while contributing to a globally distributed development team.
  
  
If you want your work to have visible business impact across a global manufacturing organization, Husky offers the opportunity to contribute to enterprise applications that support our day-to-day operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technical Implementation
  
  

* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics AX applications and supporting enterprise solutions.

Delivery & Execution Excellence

* Deliver high-quality software increments aligned with agreed priorities and sprint goals.

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

Incident & Operational Support

* Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components.

Collaboration & Mentorship
  
  

* Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams.
* Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers.
* Contribute to continuous improvement within the team.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.

* Strong hands-on experience developing, customizing, and maintaining Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 R3 applications using X++, MorphX, and Application Object Tree (AOT).

* Experience with Dynamics AX integration technologies, including Application Integration Framework (AIF), Data Import and Export Framework (DIXF), WCF, and SOAP/XML web services.

title: AI Developer – For Chennai location
description:
**About Us**
**Cognet HRO**
is a leading Business Process Outsourcing Services Company providing full range of
**HR and F&A**
services to
**US based clients ,**
With over 17 years of rich experience in
**Payroll Tax, Benefits S & HR Administration, Finance & Accounting , Sales Support**
.
**CogNet**
has been serving the PEO, ASO, HRO and HR Technology spaces since our inception. We help organizations extend their capabilities through simplified implementation, productivity performance measured to the minute, easy collaboration, and transparent pricing built around real time utilization. Our extensive expertise, data library, and workflow development tools accelerates the client implementation process .We have developed a deep expertise of process and technology in our Services , which allows us to rapidly deliver value to our clients.
**Cognet**
has been delivering outsourced solutions to the clients around the Globe.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
CogNet HR Solutions is seeking an AI Developer to design and build our AI-powered intelligent document processing and workflow automation platform which will process complex business documents such as PDFs, scanned documents, spreadsheets, forms, invoices, payroll reports, insurance documents, loss runs, applications, contracts, and other structured and unstructured data.
  
  
The AI Developer will work across the complete AI pipeline from document ingestion and classification through extraction, validation, reasoning, workflow automation, human review, and enterprise integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take AI solutions from prototype to secure, reliable production.
  
  
**Preferred Technology Stack**
AI / LLM: OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Hugging Face, vision-language models.
  
  
AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, and agent/tool-calling frameworks.
  
  
Programming: Strong Python proficiency; FastAPI, Pydantic, REST APIs, JSON and JSON Schema. Experience integrating AI services with C# / ASP.NET Core is highly desirable.
  
  
Document Processing: PyMuPDF/PDF libraries, OCR technologies, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, Document AI, OpenCV, and Excel processing.
  
  
Data: SQL Server/PostgreSQL, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, Redis or equivalent caching.
  
  
Cloud / DevOps: AWS, Docker, Git, CI/CD, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch, SQS or equivalent messaging/queue technologies.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
AI & LLM Development
  
  

* Design and develop AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build AI agents for document classification, extraction, validation, reasoning, and workflow execution.
* Develop structured extraction pipelines that convert unstructured documents into validated JSON and database records.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and agent workflows.
* Evaluate models based on accuracy, latency, security, and cost.
* Build confidence scoring and human-review routing for exceptions.
* Implement guardrails and validation to minimize hallucinations and incorrect extraction.

Intelligent Document Processing
  
  
Build document-processing pipelines supporting: PDF / Images / Excel / Word / Email → Classification → OCR/Vision → AI Extraction → Validation → Business Rules → Human Review → API/Database.
  
  

* Document type detection and classification.
* OCR and vision-based document understanding.
* Table, form, key-value, and entity extraction.
* Multi-page processing, document splitting, and routing.
* Cross-document comparison and reconciliation.
* Confidence scoring, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop review.
* Structured JSON output generation.

Agentic Workflow Development
  
  

* Develop agents that identify document types and select appropriate extraction schemas.
* Extract and validate information against business rules.
* Compare multiple documents and identify missing or inconsistent information.
* Call APIs and enterprise systems and route documents to appropriate workflows.
* Generate summaries and recommendations and escalate exceptions for human review.
* Design reliable orchestration with retries, logging, fallbacks, and error handling.

Application & API Development
  
  

* Develop backend AI services and REST APIs.
* Integrate AI services with CogNet applications and third-party enterprise platforms.
* Build asynchronous/background processing for large document workloads.
* Design scalable queues and batch-processing capabilities.
* Implement secure API authentication and authorization.

Cloud & Production AI
  
  

* Deploy and operate AI applications on AWS.
* Build containerized applications using Docker.
* Implement scalable AI inference and document-processing architectures.
* Monitor model performance, latency, token consumption, failures, and cost.
* Implement production logging, monitoring, retries, and exception handling.

RAG & Enterprise Search
  
  

* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and hybrid search.
* Chunking strategies, metadata filtering, document retrieval, and citation/source grounding.
* Enterprise document search or knowledge-management experience is an advantage.

AI Quality & Evaluation
  
  

* Create AI evaluation datasets and measure extraction accuracy.
* Compare model performance and track false positives/false negatives.
* Test prompts and extraction schemas and implement AI regression testing.
* Monitor production AI quality and optimize model selection for accuracy, speed, and cost.

Security & Data Privacy
  
  

* Encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access control, and secure API design.
* Secrets management, audit logging, data isolation, and PII handling.
* Secure LLM integration and protection against prompt injection and malicious documents.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 5+ years of software development experience.
* Strong Python programming skills and practical experience building applications using LLM APIs.
* Experience developing REST APIs and backend services.
* Experience processing PDFs and other business documents.
* Strong understanding of structured and unstructured data and SQL databases.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) and AI agents/agentic workflows.
* Insurance or Workers’ Compensation documents, payroll/HR data, or financial documents.
* Invoice processing, document reconciliation, and enterprise workflow automation.
* RAG applications, AWS Bedrock, AWS Textract, OpenAI APIs, or high-volume document-processing systems.

What You Will Build
  
  
Document Upload → Automatic Classification → AI Extraction → Validation → Human Review → Workflow → Enterprise Integration
  
  

* Insurance submission processing and Workers’ Compensation loss-run analysis.
* Payroll and HR document extraction.
* Benefits reconciliation, invoice processing, and bank reconciliation.
* Contract/form extraction, document comparison, and AI-powered enterprise document search.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Build production-ready document AI pipelines supporting multiple document types and configurable schemas.
* Achieve measurable extraction accuracy and establish automated evaluation and monitoring.
* Develop reusable AI agents and services and integrate Drive with CogNet applications.
* Implement human-in-the-loop exception workflows.
* Improve document-processing speed and automation rates while reducing inference cost.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
We are looking for a builder rather than someone focused only on AI research. The ideal candidate can take a business problem such as: “Read these 200-page insurance documents, identify the document types, extract the required information, validate the information, identify exceptions, and return structured data through an API,” and design and implement the complete production solution.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable experimenting with new AI models while maintaining the engineering discipline required for secure, reliable enterprise software.

title: Senior Engineer- Dot Net
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Energy Systems**
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
  
  
This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
  
  
This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
  
  
This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
  
  
\*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering & Delivery**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.
* NET Application Development
* Develop modern API capabilities using C#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies.
* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability & Security**

* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration & Technical Ownership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team.

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong production experience developing backend applications and services using C# and modern .NET.

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools

description:

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Medior to Senior Power BI Developer / Consultant to deliver reporting and analytics solutions as part of the implementation of a second enterprise data lake within a global FMCG/CPG organisation.

Working closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers and Data Architects, you will transform curated data from Azure, Databricks and SAP S/4HANA into trusted semantic models, dashboards and reports. The role requires strong technical Power BI expertise alongside the ability to understand business processes and translate reporting needs into practical analytical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and clarify reporting requirements with stakeholders across sales, supply chain, procurement, manufacturing and finance.
* Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, dashboards and reports using data from the Azure data platform.

* Support testing, deployment, documentation, user training and ongoing report maintenance.
* Promote reusable semantic models and consistent reporting standards.

**Required Experience and Expertise**

* Proven hands-on experience developing Power BI solutions in an enterprise environment.
* Strong expertise in DAX, Power Query, SQL and dimensional data modelling.
* Experience with Power BI Service, semantic models, refresh configuration and row-level security.
* Experience consuming data from Azure-based platforms, including Azure Databricks and data lake environments.
* Experience reporting on SAP S/4HANA data, with an understanding of relevant business processes and data relationships.
* Experience in the FMCG/CPG industry.
* Ability to define and validate business KPIs across areas such as sales performance, inventory, service levels, supply chain, procurement or finance.
* Experience troubleshooting data discrepancies and improving report and model performance.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to turn business requirements into clear, usable reports.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience introducing reporting on a newly implemented data lake.
* Familiarity with Power BI deployment pipelines, version control and governed self-service reporting.
* Experience with incremental refresh and selecting appropriate Import or DirectQuery approaches.
* Exposure to global reporting, multiple currencies and shared KPI definitions.
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing and business adoption.

Walmart’s Enterprise Business Services (EBS) is a powerhouse of several exceptional teams delivering world-class technology solutions and services making a profound impact at every level of Walmart.
  
  
As a key part of Walmart Global Tech, our teams set the bar for operational excellence and leverage emerging technology to support millions of customers, associates, and stakeholders worldwide. Each time an associate turns on their laptop, a customer makes a purchase, a new supplier is onboarded, the company closes the books, physical and legal risk is avoided, and when we pay our associates consistently and accurately, that is EBS. Joining EBS means embarking on a journey of limitless growth, relentless innovation, and the chance to set new industry standards that shape the future of Walmart.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Guide the team in architectural decisions and best practices for building scalable applications.
  
  
Drive design, development, implementation and documentation
  
  
Build, test and deploy cutting edge solutions at scale, impacting associates of Walmart worldwide.
  
  
Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community.
  
  
Engage with Product Management and Business to drive the agenda, set your priorities and deliver awesome products.
  
  
Drive the success of the implementation by applying technical skills, to design and build enhanced processes and technical solutions in support of strategic initiatives.
  
  
Work closely with the Architects and cross functional teams and follow established practices for the delivery of solutions meeting QCD (Quality, Cost & Delivery). Within the established architectural guidelines.
  
  
Work with senior leadership to chart out the future roadmap of the products
  
  
Participate in hiring and build teams enabling them to be high performing agile teams.
  
  
Interact closely for requirements with Business owners and technical teams both within India and across the globe.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related field, with minimum 10+ years of experience in software design, development and automated deployments.
  
  
Hands on experience building Java-based backend systems and experience of working in cloud based solutions is a must. Should be proficient in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and Spark.
  
  
Have prior experience in delivering highly scalable large scale data processing Java applications.
  
  
Strong in high and low level system design. Should be experienced in designing data intensive applications in open stack.
  
  
A good understanding of CS Fundamentals, Microservices, Data Structures, Algorithms & Problem Solving
  
  
Should be experienced in CICD development environments/tools including, but not limited to, Git, Maven, Jenkins.
  
  
Strong in writing modular and testable code and test cases (unit, functional and integration) using frameworks like JUnit, Mockito, and Mock MVC
  
  
Should be experienced in microservices architecture. Possesses good understanding of distributed concepts, common design principles, design patterns and cloud native development concepts.
  
  
Hands-on experience in Spring boot, concurrency, garbage collection, RESTful services, data caching services and ORM tools.
  
  
Experience working with Relational Database and writing complex OLAP, OLTP and SQL queries.
  
  
Provide multiple alternatives for development frameworks, libraries, and tools.
  
  
Experience in working with NoSQL Databases like cosmos DB.
  
  
Experience in working with Caching technology like Redis, Mem cache or other related Systems.
  
  
Experience in event based systems like Kafka.
  
  
Experience utilizing monitoring and alert tools like Prometheus, Splunk, and other related systems and excellent in debugging and troubleshooting issues.
  
  
Exposure to Containerization tools like Docker, Helm, Kubernetes.
  
  
Knowledge of public cloud platforms like Azure, GCP etc. will be an added advantage.
  
  
An understanding of Mainframe databases will be an added advantage.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications...Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications.
  
  
Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 5 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.
  
  
Option 2: 7 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications...Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.
  
  
Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area., We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart’s accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.
