Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.

* Operational Excellence: Manage delivery workflows, gateways, and refresh strategies; diagnose and resolve issues related to reports, models, and security throughout the entire flow to keep solutions reliable.
* Agile Delivery: Estimate work, manage dependencies and risks, run UAT, and deliver several projects simultaneously in Agile or Scrum environments.
* Omnichannel Insight Enablement: Interpret campaign and channel metrics to generate insights that improve customer engagement and commercial impact across markets.


**Essential Skills/Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 4\- 6 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or data management, with at least 4years of hands\-on Power BI solution delivery.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and row\-level security.
* Expertise in DAX, Power Query, dimensional modelling, star schemas, calculation design, and performance optimisation for large or complex data models.
* Strong SQL skills and experience integrating data from relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, files, and enterprise applications.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot report, model, refresh, gateway, security, and data\-quality issues across the end\-to\-end reporting flow.
* Experience with requirements elicitation, technical design, estimation, documentation, testing, source\-to\-report reconciliation, UAT, deployment, and production support.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance, information security, access controls, data lineage, quality management, and controlled release practices.
* Proven experience leading technical discussions, reviewing builds and code, mentoring developers, and influencing collaborators without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, prioritisation, and communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Experience delivering multiple initiatives in parallel within Agile or Scrum teams, including risk management, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
* Knowledge of omnichannel, commercial, or digital marketing analytics and experience translating campaign and channel metrics into actionable insights.


**Desirable Skills/Experience**
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry, particularly commercial or omnichannel reporting.

* Familiarity with DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer, source control, CI/CD, Power Automate, REST APIs, or scripting for administration and automation.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or a relevant Microsoft Fabric certification.

description:
**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 We are hiring talented and creative ML engineer for AIML platform team based in Bangalore India, you will be customer\-centric, strategic \& analytical in decision making and laser\-focused on executing at scale. You thrive on the challenge of building and optimizing platforms at scale, are deeply passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge technologies, and are dedicated to innovation and market success. You will have a chance to work on solving real world problems and gain practical experience in end\-to\-end Machine Learning life cycle. You will design, build, and optimize the platform for ML pipeline and data infrastructure. Additionally, you will gain domain expertise in a variety of industries, working with data scientists, researchers, and engineers to build ML models used across all PayPal domains.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**
* Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system
* Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow
* Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives
* Proactively improves existing structures \& processes
* Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems
* Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions
* Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor
* Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations


**Minimum Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications:**
* Strong proficiency in machine learning concepts, algorithms, and techniques, with hands\-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning models.
* Expertise in programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, and proficiency in machine learning libraries/frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, etc.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in AI/ML technology and industry trends, and leverage this knowledge to enhance the platform's capabilities.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong communication, listening, interpersonal, influencing, and alignment driving skills; able to convey important messages in a clear and compelling manner
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including the ability to inspire, mentor, and empower team members to achieve their full potential.
* Experience with Jupyter Notebook, Kubeflow, Airflow, Argo, GPU and HPC
* Experience building ML infrastructure or MLOps platforms and Bigdata platforms technologies such as Hadoop, BigQuery, Spark, Hive and HDFS


**Subsidiary:**
 PayPal
   

  

**Travel Percent:**
 0

* Guide junior developers by providing constructive code reviews and sharing best practices in B2C Commerce development security and performance optimization
* Ensure that all solutions adhere to organizational standards for data privacy accessibility and regulatory compliance while still delivering intuitive experiences for customers
* Align development activities with the hybrid work model by maintaining clear communication using collaboration tools effectively and supporting smooth handoffs across locations
* Drive continuous improvement by evaluating emerging B2C Commerce features and recommending practical enhancements that create measurable business outcomes


**Qualifications**
* Combine around ten to thirteen years of progressive software development experience with significant focus on complex enterprise commerce implementations
* Demonstrate deep hands on expertise in B2C Commerce platforms with a proven track record of delivering high traffic consumer facing applications
* Apply strong skills in server side programming scripting and data modeling to implement scalable and maintainable commerce services
* Use solid understanding of integration patterns and API design to connect B2C Commerce solutions with payment gateways logistics partners and internal systems
* Bring practical experience with automated testing frameworks and continuous integration pipelines to enable reliable and frequent releases

* Showcase adaptability to learn evolving commerce capabilities and apply them to support innovative digital journeys that benefit both customers and the company

title: Converter Software Engineer - Specialist
description:
**Vestas is well\-known in wind technology and actively contributes to its development. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Power \> Power Controls \> Converter Control Framework**
 The Converter Control department plays a key role in maintaining Vestas' leadership in sustainable energy. Our team develops, maintains, and assures the quality of converter control functionalities for all Vestas turbine families, while ensuring full compliance with global grid code requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join our Converter Control Department, developing next\-generation control platforms for utility\-scale wind turbines.
   

  

 You will play a key role in designing and implementing software that controls high\-power converters, enabling reliable and efficient renewable energy generation. Working closely with control engineers, system architects, platform teams, and test engineers, you will help translate advanced control concepts into robust, production\-ready embedded solutions.
   

  

 This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex real\-time challenges, helping guide technical decisions, and mentoring colleagues while remaining directly involved in software development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop embedded software for converter control systems
* Contribute to software architecture and long\-term platform evolution
* Ensure software quality, maintainability, and scalability across multiple product generations
* Review designs and code to ensure adherence to engineering standards
* Develop and maintain real\-time embedded applications in C/C\+\+
* Implement control\-oriented software running on DSPs, microcontrollers, or industrial embedded platforms
* Optimize software performance, determinism, memory usage, and execution time
* Debug complex issues across software, hardware, and system interfaces
* Support system integration, validation, and commissioning activities while developing automated tests and verification strategies
* Contribute to SIL, HIL, and system\-level validation activities while analyzing field issues and supporting root\-cause investigations


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Embedded Software / Electronics / Similar specialization
* 10 \+ years of experience with embedded software development environments
* Good understanding of software configuration management and version control
* Proficiency with industry tools such as Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Knowledge of software integration and release processes
* Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams
* Skilled at diagnosing issues and developing practical solutions


**Competencies**
* Ability to work on their own through complex technical problems
* Experience working with remote, multi\-location teams
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Possesses a global mindset with deep cultural understanding
* Applies a systems engineering approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Results\-oriented, receptive to different perspectives, and thrives in an international, multicultural environment
* Mentors junior and mid\-level engineers
* Shares best practices in embedded development and software engineering
* Supports continuous improvement in development processes and tools


**What We Offer**
 We offer you a job in a truly global and collaborative organization with great opportunities for cross\-disciplinary and personal development, where emphasis is placed on the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will benefit from a collaborative, professional atmosphere supported by great technical skill and an inspiring culture. You will be directly involved in facilitating the development of a core product and service, which is of utmost importance to our customers.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary workplace will be Vestas India, Chennai.
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including before the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 15th October 2026\.
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
   

  

 To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

description:

**Senior Engineer, Technical Operations**
**Your role in helping us shape the future:**
 As a
 **Sr. Engineer, Technical Operations,** 
 you will be an initial point of contact for software deployments, production issues (Software) related to SES Infight’s core services such as In\-Flight Connectivity (IFC)/In\-Flight Entertainment (IFE)/IPTV on retrofit and next generation Onboard Experience (OX) architectures and Satellite network performance. You will have desire to gain thorough technical knowledge on end\-to\-end system for providing quick analysis and driving resolution on production issues. In addition, you will be creating various dashboards and status reports for executives and end customers. You will be expected to build strong system/network level technical knowledge and use critical thinking to resolve issues faster.
   

  

 Additional responsibilities include but not limited to engage in PI (Agile teams) to understand the roadmap of upcoming features and services, lead the strategic oversight of platform and network performance, ensuring optimal performance, high reliability, and exceptional end\-user experience, lab setup for reproducing field issues and writing automation scripts for generating reports.
   

  

**Are you up to the challenge?**
* Desire to learn and champion new technologies and overall end\-to\-end system
* Develop a strong background in SES Infight’s technology platforms (ESA, KU, 2KU, ATG, ATG4 and autonomous IFE/IPTV) as well as third party technologies
* Understanding complex systems and able to diagnose and isolate the failures to a product/component level
* Deploying software to aircraft and monitor deployment performance
* Generate reports by fleet, technology, or airlines to assess the defect impact

* Create reports for complex/critical production issues for senior management

* Support returned box analysis from production
* Support the field operation team by troubleshooting/triaging SW issues by following the defect management process (SPI/IRB), while being a strong voice for process adherence.
* Lead the resolution of network performance issues through strategic coordination across internal teams and provide expert technical support for airline performance and customer escalations to SES’s customer\-facing teams.
* Independently educate and manage internal and external stakeholders on performance metrics such as Latency, Speed, Packet Loss, Jitter, and the utilization of managed service fabric. Provide strategic guidance to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead comprehensive reviews and analyses of existing data collection systems. Provide strategic recommendations on improvements, maintenance, or other factors to significantly enhance system performance, reliability, and efficiency.
* Occasional travel to support new install/maintenance activities
* Ability to work at IST overnight \-\- till 3pm US Chicago time
* Rotation of shift every quarter to half year


**You should have:**
* System thinking skills for isolating issues within a complex network
* BS degree in Engineering/Computer Science disciplines
* 10\+ years of system level troubleshooting experience working on complex systems
* 5 years of relevant experience in the satellite and/or telecommunications industry
* TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director
* JQL, SQL, Python, Java, Go, Git, Jenkins (CI), Spinnaker (CD), AWS OpenSearch
* Tableau, Power BI, Network Analysis
* Excellent Verbal/written communication skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong understanding of capacity and time management
* Flexibility to work occasional weekends or off hours, as emergencies arise
* Proactively seek continuous learning and continuous improvements
* Mentor new members and create personal development goals


**It would be nice if you had:**
* Strong networking background with CCNA/CCNE certifications
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe PI), DevOps and SRE
* Exceptional techno\-commercial business acumen in satellite communication network rollout, influencing strategic decisions and project success.
* Advanced technical competency in VSAT Network Platform operation methodologies and mastery of TDMA systems such as Gilat with comprehensive knowledge of their functionality, performance, and system operations.


**What it’s like to work with us:**
 Intelsat is connecting the world and transforming the satellite and inflight connectivity landscape by reaching beyond the traditional satellite industry. We are defining new products that will open new, profitable markets. We connect the aviation industry and air travelers with innovative technology and applications, and we do it all in a high\-energy environment that welcomes the next challenge. To help us reach this goal, you should be a bold thinker who will perform a key role in shaping Intelsat innovation for years to come.
   

  

* We emphasize personal and professional growth
* Awesome benefits including PTO, medical, tuition reimbursement, and training

 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
   

  

 As a Principal Engineer / architect you will be responsible for creating a technical strategy and coordinating the designs for meeting the needs of Toast’s largest restaurant brands. You will partner with Product Managers to develop the technology roadmap that enables enterprise customers to leverage the power of Toast. You will also work closely with technical leaders and implementation teams across the organization to deliver robust, scalable solutions with integrations to customers’ external systems. While the role is primarily internally\-facing, it requires infrequent interactions with enterprise customers, listening to their requirements and providing expert guidance as they deploy Toast.
   

  

 If you’re a technical leader or a solutions architect, experienced with enterprise SaaS, passionate about customer value, and a great collaborator, read on!
   

  

**A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)**
* Lead the evolution of Toast’s backend architecture, frameworks, and data models with a strong focus on delivery efficiency, system scalability, and resilience.
* Design and build the next generation of accounting and financial systems using Java, Kotlin, DynamoDB, Pulsar, GraphQL, Big Data tools, and more.
* Define and implement scalable engineering practices, delivery frameworks, and coding standards that raise the technical bar across the org.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, UX, QA, and multiple engineering teams to deliver robust, customer\-facing solutions.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across business units, aligning technology strategies with key company objectives.
* Champion data\-driven decision making by developing strategies and prioritizing initiatives with high impact on user and business outcomes.
* Mentor and grow engineers across levels, promoting a culture of inclusivity, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.
* Guide and influence the broader technical roadmap and architecture strategy for Toast.
* Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building \- contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team


**What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)**
* 12\+ years of experience designing and delivering complex, scalable backend systems.
* Proven technical leadership on mission\-critical projects, with the ability to influence across multiple teams.
* Strong experience building distributed, event\-driven architectures and microservices in Java, Kotlin, Scala, or similar OOP languages.
* Deep understanding of data architecture and schema design; experience with DynamoDB is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong knowledge of modern database systems (Postgres, SQL Server, DynamoDB).
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, delivering value continuously.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to break down complexity and drive solutions that scale.
* A passion for building impactful products with a customer\-first mindset.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills—respectful, empathetic, humble, and inclusive.
* A growth mindset with a desire to constantly learn and uplift others.
* Comfortable balancing velocity with platform stability and long\-term architecture goals.
* Comfortable using AI\-powered engineering tools to improve developer productivity, code quality, and technical decision\-making, with the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI\-generated solutions.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating AI into the software development lifecycle to improve engineering effectiveness, and the ability to champion best practices for responsible, secure, and high\-impact AI adoption across engineering teams.


**AI at Toast**
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
   

  

**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**
 We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast\-benefits.
   

  

**How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process**
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note\-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real\-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai\-in\-hiring
   

  

**Our Approach to Hybrid Working**
 We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in\-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in\-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations\-toast
   

  

**People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success**
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: HCL WebSphere Commerce Developer
description:
Design, develop (code), test, and debug applications on HD Supply’s B2B eCommerce platform. Provide ready\-to\-serve experience and development subject\-matter expertise across the HCL Commerce / WebSphere Commerce (WCS) v8 storefront and the adjacent Next.js and Spring Boot surfaces that now share customer traffic with it. Maintain, enhance, and deliver solutions for commerce applications. Assist team members and project leads in day\-to\-day project work during dual\-run (legacy commerce engine \+ modern storefront).
 



  





**Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities** 



* Design and develop application components in an Agile environment — WCS storefront and business logic, Java/Spring Boot services, and Next.js / React storefront work as assigned.
* Participate in gathering requirements, documenting and designing HCL Commerce / WCS functionality and related enhancements. Support application integration testing, integration development, data conversion, and cut\-over activities.
* Design, develop, and implement multi\-tier commerce applications (web and backend) to support B2B business requirements, including punchout and other customer purchasing\-system channels where those flows still run on Commerce.
* Create and review designs; identify re\-usability, performance issues, and best practices for Commerce, REST/SOAP services, and Java.
* Support the full life cycle of storefront pages, store data, store business logic, customization of WebSphere / HCL Commerce tools, and integration with back\-end systems (including services that sit in front of or beside Commerce).
* Implement Java\-based solutions for public\-facing B2B websites based on business requirements; extend or consume Spring Boot APIs that wrap or replace Commerce capabilities as pages move off WCS.
* Contribute to Next.js / React storefront work (pages, data fetching, integration with Commerce or microservice APIs) so migrated and unmigrated journeys stay consistent.
* Perform unit testing before moving code/configuration to QA. Research defects and solve for root cause across WCS, Spring Boot, and Next.js as the defect spans those layers.
* Identify key barriers and core problems; apply problem\-solving skills to complex situations. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in a dual\-run architecture (legacy Commerce runtime plus modern storefront).



  





**Skills and Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience (4\+ years professional).
* 5\+ years expertise in HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x — store customization, business logic, tools, catalog/order/user flows, and integration with back\-end systems. v8 experience is the hiring bar; later Commerce versions are a plus, not a substitute.
* 5\+ years Java development and OOD skills on large IT systems (J2EE on WebSphere Application Server strongly preferred).
* 3\+ years Spring / Spring MVC; hands\-on Spring Boot (REST APIs, service integration) required — not “Spring on a résumé only.”
* 5\+ years web services (REST and SOAP).
* 5\+ years source control (Git required; SVN/CVS acceptable as prior experience).
* 3\+ years JavaScript, HTML, CSS; Next.js and React experience required (production storefront or equivalent, not tutorials\-only). TypeScript preferred.
* Experience with Agile delivery using Atlassian tools (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence).
* Strong communication skills; proven team player.



  





**Preferred** 



* B2B commerce, punchout, and/or mobile commerce business models.
* Headless or composable commerce patterns (API\-first storefront consuming Commerce or BFF/microservices). MuleSoft or similar iPaaS is a plus, not required.
* Additional JS frameworks (Angular, Vue) as secondary experience.
* Exposure to search (Solr), session/page cache (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (e.g. Optimizely or equivalent) alongside a commerce engine.
* Experience working Preview vs Runtime (authoring/preview vs customer\-facing) Commerce stacks without treating them as the same environment.

**Job Summary**

title: Software Engineer, Workday
description:
Join us as a Software Engineer, Workday
   

  

* This is an opportunity for a driven Software Engineer to take on an exciting new career challenge
* Day\-to\-day, you'll build a wide network of stakeholders of varying levels of seniority
* It’s a chance to hone your existing technical skills and advance your career
* We're offering this role at senior analyst level


 What you'll do
   

  

 In your new role, you’ll engineer and maintain innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust solutions. You’ll be working within a feature team and using your extensive experience to engineer software, scripts and tools that are often complex, as well as liaising with other engineers, architects and business analysts across the platform.
   

  

**You’ll Also Be**
* Producing complex and critical software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
* Working in permanent teams who are responsible for the full life cycle, from initial development, through enhancement and maintenance to replacement or decommissioning
* Collaborating to optimise our software engineering capability
* Designing, producing, testing and implementing our working code
* Working across the life cycle, from requirements analysis and design, through coding to testing, deployment and operations

 You’ll need a background in software engineering, software design, architecture, and an understanding of how your area of expertise supports our customers. You'll need at least three years of experience working on Workday SaaS solutions delivery, with hands\-on expertise in gathering and analysing requirements, designing, developing, testing, and implementing Workday Security solutions. You'll be need experience in understanding business requirements, managing and controlling access to domains and business processes, creating and maintaining security groups, and supporting security governance across the platform.
   

  

 You'll also need practical experience with Workday configurable security and security maintenance, including User\-Based and Role\-Based Security Groups, ISU, and ISSG. Additionally, you'll need exerience in supporting internal and external audit requirements by retrieving Workday evidence, leveraging tools such as Kainos Audit, and ensuring compliance with security and audit standards.
   

  

**You’ll Also Need**
* Experience of working with development and testing tools, bug tracking tools and wikis
* Experience in multiple programming languages or low code toolsets
* Experience of DevOps, Testing and Agile methodology and associated toolsets
* A background in solving highly complex, analytical and numerical problems
* Experience of implementing programming best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance

description:
**Are you an experienced Salesforce professional looking to build your expertise in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and enterprise Quote\-to\-Cash transformation?** 




 Join
 **LevelShift as a Technical Specialist ? Salesforce Revenue Cloud,** 
 where you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions. You'll work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, developers, integration teams, QA, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and deliver enterprise\-grade Quote\-to\-Cash capability.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**As a Technical Specialist ? Salesforce Revenue Cloud at LevelShift, you will:** 



* Develop and customize Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce Platform technologies.
* Configure and enhance Product Catalogs, Pricing, Quoting, and Revenue Cloud capabilities to support end\-to\-end Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) business processes.
* Design and implement scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce best practices, security standards, and enterprise architecture.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and custom Salesforce functionality based on business and technical requirements.
* Design and develop integrations between Salesforce, ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications using REST APIs and modern integration frameworks.
* Support data migration activities, including data mapping, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation, and data quality.
* Participate in solution design, technical estimation, development, testing, deployment, and release management activities.
* Work with solution architects and functional consultants to translate Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce coding standards, security best practices, integration patterns, and development guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Revenue Cloud, Apex, LWC, integrations, data, configurations, and Salesforce platform functionality.
* Support SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and technical issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain technical design documents, data mappings, integration specifications, deployment documents, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with QA teams to develop test scenarios, support defect resolution, and ensure solution quality.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and provide effective technical solutions.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve Revenue Cloud processes, automation, system performance, scalability, and overall solution quality
 **.**



  





**How This Role Uses AI** 



* Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance Salesforce development, solution design, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and engineering productivity while ensuring responsible AI usage.
* Utilize AI\-assisted development for Apex, LWC, Salesforce Flows, integrations, debugging, technical documentation, code reviews, and test\-case generation.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein AI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and improve solution delivery.
* Explore opportunities to use AI for Quote\-to\-Cash automation, business process optimization, data analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and developer productivity.
* Ensure AI\-assisted development follows appropriate data privacy, security, governance, and Salesforce development standards.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing Revenue Cloud development, testing, support, monitoring, and technical workflows.



  





**Your Skillset** 



* 5?7 years of experience in Salesforce development, implementation, technical consulting, or solution delivery, with strong hands\-on experience in Salesforce Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA).
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and Salesforce Platform.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Product Catalog, Pricing, Quoting, and Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) processes.
* Experience implementing and configuring Revenue Cloud (RLM/RCA) capabilities for enterprise business requirements.
* Strong experience developing custom Apex classes, triggers, LWC components, Flows, and Salesforce customizations.
* Experience designing and implementing REST API integrations between Salesforce and external applications.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP systems, middleware, and third\-party applications.
* Good understanding of data migration, data transformation, data validation, and Salesforce data management.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing, profiles, permission sets, governor limits, platform limitations, and development best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps, version control, deployment processes, testing frameworks, and release management.
* Experience performing code reviews, technical troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, deployment, production support, defect management, and release activities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with architects, functional consultants, QA teams, integration teams, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver scalable solutions within project timelines.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Salesforce platform innovations, AI, integrations, and emerging Salesforce technologies.



  





**Why LevelShift?** 



* Accelerate your career by working on enterprise\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Quote\-to\-Cash transformation initiatives for global customers.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to the latest Salesforce innovations, including Revenue Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein AI, and AI\-assisted development.
* Work with experienced Salesforce architects, consultants, developers, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Gain experience across challenging Revenue Cloud implementations, integrations, data migration, and enterprise application development.

* Be part of a culture that values innovation, technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, professional development programs, Salesforce certification support, and exposure to emerging Salesforce and AI technologies.

**About CloudBees**
 CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior SailPoint Developer** 
 , you will drive the design, development, configuration, implementation, integration, and continuous enhancement of SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions. You will work closely with the Senior SailPoint Engineering Lead and partner with IAM, cloud, infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver scalable and secure identity governance solutions across hybrid, cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in implementing identity governance, lifecycle management, provisioning, access certifications, role management, entitlement governance, cloud identity governance, application onboarding, and automation capabilities. As a highly hands\-on engineering professional, you will contribute to platform modernization, migration initiatives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while leveraging modern identity security practices and cloud\-native governance capabilities.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, develop, configure, test, and deploy SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions.
* Develop and maintain IIQ workflows, lifecycle events, provisioning policies, business processes, rules, forms, reports, customizations, plugins, and application integrations.
* Configure and support ISC sources, access profiles, roles, lifecycle states, identity processing, certifications, provisioning policies, workflows, and event triggers.
* Design, configure, and support Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes across IIQ and ISC environments.
* Implement and support onboarding of enterprise applications, authoritative sources, directories, databases, SaaS platforms, cloud services, and enterprise systems.
* Develop integrations using REST APIs, Web Services, SCIM, JDBC, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, XML, JSON, Java, and BeanShell technologies.
* Configure and support identity aggregation, correlation, reconciliation, and identity data quality processes.

description:

To conduct complex maintenance procedures for applications independently. Analyze application logs, maintenance activity data, performance data and provide analysis; Evaluate change requests to identify those which are valid and feasible.

 Coordinates, completes, and oversees job\-related activities and assignments by developing and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders; supporting plans and initiatives to meet customer and business needs; identifying and communicating goals and objectives; building accountability for and measuring progress in achieving results; identifying and addressing improvement opportunities; and demonstrating adaptability and promoting continuous learning.

 Agile Methodology, Software Design, Project Management

**About CloudBees**
 CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
   

  

 Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate.  CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
   

  

 Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
   

  

 Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re embedding AI across the entire software development lifecycle to reduce the time it takes to understand, triage, and resolve problems \- from planning and code, through CI/CD, to production systems.
   

  

 The AI Foundation team builds the platform infrastructure that makes AI\-assisted software delivery possible inside CloudBees (and our CloudBees Unify product). Our systems ingest signals from pipelines, pull requests, source\-code, tests, and incidents \- and need to process them reliably, at scale, in production.
   

  

 This is a platform engineering role. Your primary identity here is as someone who writes production\-quality Go, operates confidently in Kubernetes\-native environments, and takes observability seriously as a design constraint, not an afterthought.
   

  

 You’ll work in an environment where AI tooling is part of how the team operates \- from development through to the systems we ship. That means being an effective conductor: knowing how to direct AI tooling, decompose problems for it, and apply the same critical judgement to its output that you would to any other contributor’s work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Platform Engineering:**
* Design, build, and operate Go services running on Kubernetes that form the backbone of our agent infrastructure
* Own reliability for production systems \- define SLOs, write runbooks, and be accountable when things go wrong
* Instrument everything: structured logging, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and metrics that surface both system health and the behaviour of the AI workflows running on top
* Contribute to Kubernetes\-native patterns: operators, CRDs, workload isolation, and resource management for dynamic agent workloads
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support rapid, safe iteration \- using AI tooling as a natural part of that workflow


**Engineering in an AI\-Native Environment:**
* Use AI development tooling effectively \- generating, reviewing, and steering code with the same rigour you’d apply to any PR
* Decompose and delegate work to AI agents where appropriate, and know when not to \- catching drift, validating output, and maintaining ownership of outcomes
* Review AI\-generated code with an understanding of its specific failure modes: plausible\-looking but subtly wrong logic, missing edge cases, and over\-confident implementations
* Contribute to the team’s shared judgement on when new models, frameworks, or tooling change the architecture assumptions we’re building on


**Technical Collaboration:**
* Partner with the broader AI Foundation team to establish platform patterns that other teams adopt
* Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to build vs buy decisions
* Mentor more junior engineers and raise the team’s bar for production readiness and operational discipline


**Working Across Disciplines:**
* You'll work closely with ML engineers and agentic systems engineers on the team, providing the platform foundation \- reliability, observability, deployment infrastructure \- that lets their work reach production safely.
* This is a genuine collaboration: you'll bring rigour to how their systems are built and operated, and they'll bring you along on the AI domain specifics \- model behaviour, context design, evaluation approaches \- as the work demands.
* You won't be expected to arrive knowing that space deeply; you will be expected to engage with it seriously.


**What We're Looking For**
**Required:**
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time operating at senior level
* Strong Go \- idiomatic, well\-tested, production\-shipped (if you meet all the other requirements, but have a different language \- please apply)
* Solid Kubernetes operations experience: you’ve debugged real production incidents, understand the scheduler, and know when a CRD is the wrong answer
* Hands\-on observability experience \- OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, distributed tracing \- and a genuine conviction that unobservable systems are untrustworthy
* Cloud\-native background on AWS or GCP: IAM, managed Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code
* Comfortable working in an AI\-augmented development environment \- directing tools, critically evaluating their output, and maintaining engineering rigour throughout
* Demonstrated ability to own production systems end\-to\-end: design, ship, monitor, iterate


**Preferred:**
* Familiarity with Tekton, Jenkins, Argo Workflows, or similar pipeline infrastructure
* Exposure to how LLM\-based systems are structured \- enough to reason about them as infrastructure dependencies, not black boxes
* Experience contributing to platform or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams


**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 Months:**
* Shipping production code to the AI Foundation platform with minimal ramp\-up
* Owning at least one service end\-to\-end: SLOs, alerts, and runbooks included
* Identifying and addressing a meaningful observability gap in an existing workflow


**3 \- 6 Months:**
* Delivering a materially improved platform capability that the team relies on
* Contributing patterns or tooling that other engineers adopt
* Being the person teammates reach for on K8s and observability questions


**6 \- 12 Months:**
* Leading a significant platform initiative from design through to production reliability
* Influencing how the team approaches build vs buy vs integrate decisions
* Raising the bar on how the team uses AI tooling in its own engineering practice


**Why This Role**
 Platform engineering here isn’t maintenance work. The systems are genuinely hard \- dynamic workloads, heterogeneous signal sources, reliability requirements that don’t bend because the underlying models are probabilistic.
   

  

 You’ll also be engineering in the way most teams will be working in a few years: AI tooling as a normal part of the workflow, with engineers who know how to get the most out of it without losing ownership of what ships.

Whether focused on project financial, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
**Service Now Developer**
**Level: Consultant**
 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

 As a ServiceNow Developer, you will be responsible for development, core configuration, and ongoing technical enhancement of Deloitte’s ServiceNow implementation. You’ll bring a solution\-focused mindset, a passion for customer service, and thrive in a dynamic, high\-velocity environment. You will also have opportunities to build foundational skills in ServiceNow’s AI and automation capabilities.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Translate functional specifications into logical technical designs; design and develop new ServiceNow workflows and processes.
* Develop and customize ServiceNow solutions (primarily ITSM) using JavaScript, Jelly, MySQL, XML, HTML, CSS, and REST/SOAP web services.
* Build and maintain custom Service Portal pages and widgets to support diverse business needs.
* Assist system administrators with incident resolution and ad\-hoc platform troubleshooting.
* Guide, support, and conduct code walkthroughs for less experienced developers as needed.
* Ensure ServiceNow development and customization align to best practices to maintain compliance.
* Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive unit and integration test plans; coordinate and perform regression testing.
* Document, track, and resolve software defects; participate in UAT and incorporate feedback from business stakeholders.
* Manage Update Set creation and migration; assist with ServiceNow platform maintenance, upgrades, and vendor coordination.
* Participate in requirements gathering, maintain technical solution documentation, and collaborate with business/IT teams.
* Integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise applications using Integration Hub or standard APIs, following secure and scalable practices.
* Develop skills in leveraging ServiceNow’s GenAI features, such as Virtual Agent, NLP\-driven ticket categorization, or AI Search, to enhance automation and workflow effectiveness.
* Assist with basic setup or integration of ServiceNow AI modules and participate in piloting small\-scale AI\-driven solutions with guidance from senior team members.


**The team**
 Our Finance Transformation practice develops and licenses a growing family of proprietary software products (see http://www.deloitte.com/ft) to assist financial institutions with a number of complex topics, such as accounting for credit deteriorated assets and the administration of investments in leveraged loans.
   

  

 We are looking to add dedicated software engineers to our team. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we provide excellent opportunities for growth and learning and invest in our talent development.
   

  

 We are looking for people who share our passion for translating ideas into relevant and innovative products in the OP to solve business problem.
   

  

**Qualifications –**
**Must have Required skillset:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related technology/business discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 3–5 years of IT industry experience, including 3\+ years of ServiceNow development.
* Strong experience configuring ServiceNow ITSM Modules using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Workflow Editor, ACLs, Script Includes, JavaScript/GLIDE, and HTML5\.
* Hands\-on experience integrating ServiceNow with other IT applications or data sources.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow best practices, solution documentation, and update set management.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills; ability to work as part of a team.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist or Certified Application Developer (preferred but not required for entry).
* Adaptable, detail\-oriented, and motivated to learn new ServiceNow and Gen AI/automation features as they emerge.


**Good to have skillset Preferred:**
* Experience implementing additional ServiceNow modules such as Customer Service Management (CSM), Integrated Risk Management (IRM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), or Security Operations (SecOps).
* Exposure to or direct experience working on real\-time AI or automation solutions within ServiceNow or related IT platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile or SDLC testing cycles.
* Experience with day\-to\-day ServiceNow platform administration.
* Awareness of ServiceNow’s AI capabilities (e.g., Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence) and enthusiasm for developing expertise in this area.
* Experience using source control tools (e.g., GitHub) for collaborative code development and maintenance.
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills with strong motivation for continuous skill development and learning.


**Education:**
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree (3 Year) within a technical field.


**Location:**
* Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Chennai/Pune


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 :

* Kafka expertise

* Producers, consumers, topics, partitions

* Integrating Kafka with Spring Boot microservices

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role \- Senior Software Engineer** 




**Location: Chennai** 




  





**Want to revolutionise fruit trade in the world?** 




 At Vegrow, we are using technology to transform one of the world's most complex and fragmented agricultural supply chains.
 



 We are building technology across the entire fruit journey — from how we source and move produce to how we monitor, inspect, pack and deliver it. Our engineering teams work across
 **scalable software systems, automation, AI and computer vision** 
 to solve real\-world problems at scale.
 



  





 One of the areas we are actively building is
 **AI\-powered voice automation for our supply operations** 
 . We are building voice agents that can interact with our supply network at scale, automate calling workflows and improve the way we engage with our partners. We are also exploring technologies such as
 **reinforcement learning to make these calling campaigns increasingly intelligent and adaptive** 
 .
 



  





 Alongside this, our broader technology organisation is building computer vision systems for
 **fruit inspection, defect detection, movement monitoring, packing and multi\-object tracking** 
 . These are examples of the kinds of challenging technology problems being solved across Vegrow.
 



 For this role, however,
 **the focus is primarily on building robust software systems and voice\-based applications** 
 . You will work as a hands\-on Senior Software Developer, owning problems end\-to\-end and contributing to the design, development and scaling of the systems that power these products.
 



  





 You do
 **not** 
 need prior experience building voice agents or working with AI. What matters most is strong software engineering fundamentals, the ability to solve complex problems, and the curiosity to learn and work with new technologies. Experience with voice, conversational AI, LLMs or related technologies is a plus.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Senior Software Developer** 
 with 4–5 years of experience who enjoys building production\-grade software and solving challenging technical problems.
 



 You should be comfortable taking ownership of a problem — understanding the requirements, designing a solution, writing clean and maintainable code, testing it, taking it to production and improving it over time.
 



 You will work closely with product, design, QA and business teams, while also contributing to technical design and engineering decisions.
 



  





**Key Role Contours** 



* Design, develop and maintain scalable, reliable and high\-performance software systems.
* Own technically challenging projects from design through development, testing, deployment and production support.
* Contribute to system design, architecture and technical decisions.
* Understand system dependencies, limitations and performance bottlenecks, and design solutions that can scale.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested and production\-ready code.
* Debug complex technical issues and improve system performance, reliability and maintainability.
* Participate actively in code reviews and help maintain strong engineering standards.
* Work closely with product, design, QA and business teams to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Break down ambiguous problems into well\-defined engineering tasks and provide reasonable estimates and implementation plans.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts where required to validate technical feasibility and reduce risks.
* Document important technical decisions, system designs and engineering practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering processes and system reliability.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions and hands\-on collaboration.
* Stay current with relevant technologies and continuously improve engineering practices.



  





**Voice \& AI Applications** 




 A key area of this role will be the opportunity to work on
 **voice automation and conversational applications** 
 as part of Vegrow's evolving technology stack.
 


* Prior experience building voice agents is a
 **nice\-to\-have, not a requirement** 
 .
* Experience with LLMs, conversational AI, speech technologies, APIs or AI\-powered applications is a plus.
* You may work on building and scaling voice agents and the backend systems that support them.
* You will have the opportunity to learn and work with emerging technologies as these products evolve.



  





**Success Profile** 



* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **4–5 years of professional software development experience.**
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages and modern software development technologies.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming and software engineering principles.
* Good understanding of system design, APIs, databases and building scalable backend systems.
* Experience building and operating production\-grade applications.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring or production systems is a plus.
* Understanding of performance, reliability and observability is desirable.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to take ownership and make sound technical decisions independently.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and work in a fast\-moving environment.



  





**What makes this role exciting?** 




 You will be solving
 **real\-world engineering problems at the intersection of software, automation and AI** 
 , with a direct impact on how fruit moves through India's supply chain.
 



 You will get the opportunity to build systems that interact with people and operations at scale — including
 **voice agents and automation systems** 
 — while working alongside teams building some of Vegrow's broader AI and computer vision capabilities.

description:
