 Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.
   

  

 The Enterprise Data and AI organization unites the data governance, strategy, engineering, and product teams with those responsible for AI engineering, generative AI enablement, and automation product and engineering. This group plays a pivotal role in leveraging data as a core driver of innovation and integrating AI capabilities to transform products, operations, and customer experiences. The EDAI organization also incorporates technology Research \& Development and experimentation with emerging capabilities, along with engineering support for Amex Digital Labs. This integration ensures that research breakthroughs seamlessly translate into business impact.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, prototype, and evaluate quantum algorithms to address complex computational problems in finance.
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams—including quantum scientists, data scientists, and financial engineers—to integrate quantum solutions into real\-world financial workflows.
* Develop and maintain quantum software libraries, tools, and simulation environments.
* Present technical findings internally and externally through presentations, seminars, and written documentation.
* Publish high\-quality research and represent the organization at leading conferences and industry forums.


**Qualifications**
* Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline; or equivalent industry experience.
* Minimum of 2 years of hands\-on experience in quantum computing (QC) or quantum information science (QIS).
* Deep understanding of quantum information theory, including quantum algorithms, error correction, and entanglement.
* Strong foundation in discrete mathematics, numerical methods, and scientific computing.
* Proven track record of peer\-reviewed publications in quantum computing or closely related fields.
* Proficiency with one or more quantum programming frameworks: Qiskit (preferred), Cirq, Q\#, or similar platforms.
* Advanced programming skills in Python, with experience in developing robust, production\-level software.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a high level of intellectual curiosity.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and decision\-making skills.
* Familiarity with hybrid quantum\-classical approaches and variational algorithms (e.g., VQE, QAOA).
* Experience working with quantum simulators and quantum hardware platforms.
* Exposure to financial modeling, portfolio optimization, or risk analytics is a strong plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native NTN Applications)
description:
**About Us**
 One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Viasat is developing a 3GPP NTN standards\-based Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Network to support standard based devices across key use cases such as Direct to Device, Automobile and UAVs.
   

  

 RAN Apps team is responsible for the development of an ecosystem of AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent applications to configure, monitor and optimize the performance of Viasat’s LEO based satellite network especially that of the RAN subsystem in it, and integrate the ecosystem with the complete satellite ground network. These applications interface with various components of O\-RAN based NTN network – RU, DU, CU, RIC, SMO etc.
   

  

 Team member responsibilities are end\-to\-end ownership of one or more intelligent RAN applications, from requirements refining to design, development and system integration.
   

  

 This is a site‑based role, employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
* Refine initial requirements through brainstorming with peers in the team and external stakeholders.
* Develop Architecture and Design for AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent RAN applications utilizing O\-RAN framework, system performance, scalability and maintainability aspects.
* Develop test plans covering configuration, performance, stability, interoperability
* Implement the design with the support of AI productivity tools
* Test the applications at various level – unit, module, subsystem, system
* Integration with other network components (DU, CU, RIC, SMO)
* Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
* Support production \& lab environments aligned with team’s responsibility
* Update and maintain existing production applications and networks


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale cloud\-native, microservices\-based, event\-driven, distributed applications.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, fault tolerance, high availability, resiliency, consistency models, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing.
* Experience designing data\-intensive systems using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deep understanding of event\-driven architectures, including asynchronous messaging, event streaming, pub/sub patterns, and event sourcing concepts.
* Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and service\-to\-service communication patterns in distributed environments.
* Proven ability to build highly reliable and observable production systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, disaster recovery, and incident resolution.
* Good understanding of Terrestrial and/or Satellite wireless system, SMO and RIC frameworks


 Technical Expertise:
   

  

* Strong programming skills preferably in Golang or Python
* Containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
* API design and integration, including REST APIs, API versioning, backward compatibility, contract\-first development, API gateways, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and resiliency patterns.
* Event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or equivalent.
* Public cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* CI/CD and DevOps tooling, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Deployment automation using Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, CloudFormation or similar.


**What Will Help You On The Job**
* Good understanding of O\-RAN specifications, rApps,xApps development
* Hands on development experience with Golang/Python/Rust/Scripting/Cl\-CD in public cloud environment

title: GDS Cyber-DPP-Manager-AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead EMS Engineer - Systems Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Systems engineering is a cross\-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs.
   

  

 Lead system engineer is responsible for Design engineering and coordination/key technical interface to customer and vendors in execution of EMS/Sub\-station automation/Marine/O\&G/Power Projects in time, quality and budget. System engineer will also closely work with service organization to ensure that new developments are aligned with business strategy and are compliant with latest regulation and standards.

* Knowledge on Integration, configuration, simulation, and analysis of substation communication protocols such as IEC 61850(MMS/GOOSE), IEC 60870\-5\-101,104, DNP3\.0, Profinet, OPCUA, OPCDA and Modbus.
* Knowledge on Time synchronization (NTP, PTP)
* Knowledge and experience on simulation tools like DTM, IED scout, Test suite pro, Modsim.

* Knowledge on programming (Python , Embedded C , Any C\# ) is preferred.

* Knowledge on cybersecurity is preferred.

* Identify technical risks and put in place the mitigation plan
* Review solutions developed and identify opportunities for improvement of process, system, or equipment

* Comply with all company and customer health and safety regulations.


**Qualifications/Requirements**

* 10\+ years of experience in Communication protocols, Networks, Protection relays, Controls in EMS / SAS
* Experience in capturing requirements and writing technical specifications
* Understanding of communication protocols (TCP socket and Serial communications, Knowledge of DNP3, IEC 61850 and IEC 60870\-5\-101 (IEC 101\) protocols would be beneficial
* Knowledge of design principles and have the capability to write clear documentation
* Flexible, adaptable and enthusiastic approach, good great team mate and an effective communicator
* Previous experience in a similar or related role.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills, interpersonal skills
* Able to interface effectively with all levels of organization and external customers.
* Displays good interpersonal skills – is accessible and approachable.
* Anticipates customer needs and ensures they are met
* Willingness to learn with passion
* Self\-motivated, creative and a team player, with ability to come up with unique solutions to complex problems
* Capable of working with multi\-disciplined international team with good personal organization skills.
* Ability to multi\-task on a variety of projects to strict time scales
* Quickly identify best practices and apply them within the team
* Strong prioritizing and time management skills
* Willing to travel on short notice within base country and overseas for short/long term assignments
* Willing to work extended hours during the week, at weekends/holidays at critical times.
